crossRefs.note: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said to him, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you…

translations.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
translations.bsb: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
translations.asv: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
